verdict.rationale: Zero's own docs give users some control over deletion: the MCP capability list includes deleting and bulk-deleting emails, and the project can be self-hosted, so the operator controls where synced email data (stored in Durable Objects and R2) lives. No retention-policy controls or account/data-purge mechanism are documented. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, deletion of cached/stored copies (R2/Durable Object) or account data, documented data-lifecycle policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
We're now storing the user's emails in their Durable Object & an R2 bucket.
